correctness.rationale: For Clebsch Cayley graph on F_2^4 with connection differences 1,2,4,8,15, every one of the 65536 vertex masks was independently tested for induced acyclicity. The 13839 augmented faces have f-vector (1,16,120,560,1780,3696,4376,2560,650,80). Independently reconstructed greedy vertex-pivot Morse matching has 6908 pairs, 19 critical 5-cells and four critical 6-cells; full topological ordering of 77632 oriented incidences proves acyclicity. The signed 19x4 Morse differential was independently reconstructed with exact integer recurrence; rows 0,1,3,4 give a unimodular maximal minor, so the high-dimensional CW cell pairs cancel integrally and F(C) is wedge of fifteen S^5. An independent enumeration of all 1920 graph automorphisms and fixed-face Lefschetz sums gives sign(sigma)*(number of fixed vertices-1) with zero mismatches and confirms the rational sign-twisted augmentation G-module, whose two translation-character orbits have dimensions 5 and 10. No general higher folded-cube claim is proved.
